outputs.description: Micro-Star Int'l Co. Ltd. MAG 274Q X24 0x01010101

isolation: Temporary XDG roots, session D-Bus disabled for the host, package installed into the temporary root with kpackagetool6; no plasmashell, KWin or Plasma D-Bus services; the active Breeze panel was not modified.
input: Virtual uinput pointer/keyboard created only during each check; pointer placed with hl.dsp.cursor.move and restored afterwards with the previously focused window.

findings: Qt reported the layer panel at its output origin (2560,0), so mapToGlobal() of every applet was wrong.
Qt Wayland discarded the x/y that Andromeda requested for its PlasmaCore.Dialog menu: the menu layer appeared at the top-left of the output (2560,0) instead of above the panel.
Andromeda's floating avatar (PlasmaCore.Dialog type Notification) became a floating xdg toplevel in the middle of the LG (status requires-noninteractive-role-adapter).
The panel layer requested keyboard focus on demand; clicking the launcher made the panel active and hideOnWindowDeactivate hid the menu before the toggle reopened it.
The preview window was opaque white (no alpha buffer / transparent color).

changes: main: QT_WAYLAND_DISABLE_FIXED_POSITIONS set only around QApplication creation and QQuickWindow::setDefaultAlphaBuffer(true), as plasma-workspace 6.7.5 shell/main.cpp.

configurePanel publishes the anchored layer position to QWindow, uses a transparent frameless window without focus and KeyboardInteractivityNone; setPanelAcceptsInput follows the containment AcceptingInputStatus like PanelView::refreshStatus 6.7.5.
PopupAnchor: package-requested positions are clamped to the available area without the panel strip and the final position is written back to the QWindow so companion Dialogs follow it.
PackageWindows adapts output-only/Notification/OSD/Tooltip Dialogs owned by the containment as overlay layers without keyboard interactivity.
preview-isolated.py --output DESC selects an output by description (never by connector).

FocusGrab (focusgrab.cpp): hyprland_focus_grab_v1 client generated at build time from the system hyprland-protocols XML; PopupAnchor starts it when an interactive Dialog with hideOnWindowDeactivate becomes visible and hides the Dialog on cleared. Inert without the protocol (offscreen tests, other compositors).

after.output: Micro-Star Int'l Co. Ltd. MAG 274Q X24

interaction.clickOnEmptyDesktopNote: Closed through hyprland_focus_grab_v1 (second iteration, same day): whitelist = popup + panel + visible non-interactive companion Dialogs; the cleared event hides Dialogs with hideOnWindowDeactivate. Before the grab Hyprland kept keyboard focus on the OnDemand layer and nothing closed it.
interaction.avatarClick: Avatar is whitelisted (no cleared event in the log); its own handler closes the menu (root.toggle) and calls KCMLauncher.openSystemSettings('kcm_users'), which launched nothing because the preview has no session bus.

visualNotes: Translucent Plasma dialog background is drawn without blur: KWindowEffects blur is not available in Hyprland; a layer rule for the bwm-r4-* namespaces would be needed.
The preview panel draws no panel background: the BWM test shell package has no views/Panel.qml equivalent of PanelView.

tests.ctestNormal: 2/2 passed (surface-geometry 14 cases incl. panel strip, focus policy and inert focus grab; isolated-plasmoids with KDE example and Andromeda)

notVerified: Fractional scale outputs, panels on top/left/right edges, autohide and real reservations (the preview uses exclusiveZone -1).
Blur of translucent backgrounds and panel background view; focus grab with Dialogs of other packages and AppletPopup.
Other packages' Dialogs and tooltips; Dialogs created or shown before registration.
Activation of the native panel as the daily Breeze panel, migration/rollback and skin switches.
